title: Flowers in the Attic
author: V. C. Andrews
summary: After their father dies, four children and their mother move into a grand mansion owned by her wealthy, cruel father. The children are hidden away in an upstairs room, supposedly for a short time.
readIf: you want a notorious gothic page-turner that is lurid, claustrophobic and hard to put down.
skipIf: sustained abuse of children, or incest, is something you cannot read.

pairings.reason: Another story of isolated, damaged siblings in a closed house, more subtle and eerie.
A classic gothic with an oppressive mansion and a controlling older woman.
A modern dark family story built around cruelty and secrets in a household.
